title: ATLAS Application Manifest Schema
description: Formal specification for ATLAS application manifests. Note: Core fields (app_id, name, version, runtime, entrypoint) are consumed by the ATLAS OS Application Manager; metadata fields are reserved for the APPS catalogue and package manager.

app_id.description: Unique application identifier (reverse domain notation recommended, max 31 characters).

tagline.description: Short summary displayed on home launcher cards (max 47 characters).

runtime.description: Execution runtime environment. 'wasm' indicates WebAssembly bytecode; 'native' indicates relocatable native module. Note: 'builtin' is reserved for core firmware applications.

entrypoint.description: Relative path to executable or main script inside package directory. Path traversal ('..'), absolute paths, and colons are forbidden.

description.description: Extended application description for catalogue and store listings.

min_atlas_version.description: Minimum ATLAS OS version required to run this application.

icon.description: Relative path to application icon file (e.g., 'icon.png' or 'icon.raw').

permissions.description: System resources requested by this application.
